description: Change some of the application details. Only the fields given change; an empty string clears a field. Fields: salutation, address, postcode, city, state, country (two-letter code), phone_type (mobile, home or work), work_auth (object such as {"eu": true}), sponsorship (list of regions), salary_expectation (number). Only values the person actually stated.

details.description: The fields to change, see the description.
